title: The app garden added 13 new projects
summary:
A community-heavy day: 13 new apps in the directory, broader model coverage, sturdier media routes, and a cleaner contributor workflow.

The community directory picked up a substantial batch of things people built: creative tools including ViralFlow AI, SAGE, LineSketch AI, Thelas.ia, Ecoverse AI, Cinepoca, and a Gemini Telegram bot; chat projects including Debootai, HelpChatGPT, MindFlow, and SimplifyMind AI; plus Godville Heroic Moment, TeleChars AI, and more. The ecosystem continues to be a surprisingly effective index of what people do with a URL and insufficient sleep.

Both Seedream and Seedance model variants are now available, while fixes improved Bedrock token handling, audio-model detection, and image prompts containing newlines. Audio users also get clearer migration guidance as model support evolves.

GitHub issue handling was tidied up: COMMUNITY became INBOX, app submissions are kept out of the general flow, external issues receive the correct inbox label, and submission templates point to the right place. Polly, an issue-creation helper bot, joined the maintenance crew.
